title: Pope Leo cancels Assisi trip on doctors’ advice as he recovers from surgery
summary: Pope Leo XIV will miss a planned trip to Assisi next week after doctors advised against the helicopter journey to the Italian town as he recovers from thoracic surgery, the Vatican said Friday. ...…
